original.statement: The boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix and tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix settings are removed; no action needed if never configured.

of.needed: whether the Loki YAML config sets shared_store_key_prefix under the boltdb or tsdb shipper configuration (exact YAML path not given in evidence)

corrected.statement: Environments are exposed when they set -boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix, -tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix, or the corresponding YAML shipper setting (shared_store_key_prefix). Environments that set none of these need no changes.

decision.reason: [ev-76a46c52508c] says no changes are needed only if the operator has not set -boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix, -tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix or the corresponding YAML setting. So any of the three exposes the environment. The proposed condition checks only the boltdb flag, which is too narrow: it misses the tsdb flag and YAML-only configurations. The evidence does not give the exact YAML key path, so the YAML case is marked undecidable instead of guessing a path.
